messages:
Maya: deploy-bot flagged a p95 spike on the embeddings route (model-embed-v2) during the canary. Auto-rollback was suppressed due to change-window. We need a quick call: manual rollback, pin, or traffic-slice rollback?

deploy-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: canary latency anomaly on model-embed-v2. Metrics: p95=680ms, error-rate+token-drop signal=1. Trigger count 3/5. Auto-rollback suppressed (change-window: 22:00-04:00). Suggested actions: manual rollback to model-embed-v1.9 OR shift canary traffic -> 0.1 slice -> observe. Telemetry: https://telemetry.internal/redwood/canary/1736004321

Riley: what does the error-rate actually look like? if only latency and no errors we can try traffic-slice before full revert.

Maya: Riley good call. Last 10m shows latency + a small uptick in 5xxs from a single shard. Not widespread.

Tomo: Agree with slice-first. If we can cut canary to 5% and watch p95 for 10m, we avoid a full revert. But if p95 stays >500ms we should revert.

Anika: Heads-up for customer comms: if we revert pin to v1.9 we need a release-note snippet explaining performance regression with v2 and rollback rationale. I can draft.

Simon: Ops note — our rollback playbook requires an owner and a ticket. I'll open RL-173600 and assign an on-call. Who will run the exec?

Maya: Tomo will run the traffic-slice rollback then escalate to full rollback if threshold breached. Tomo you good to own the exec?

Tomo: on it. Plan: run `rclient traffic set --route embeddings --slice 0.05 --model model-embed-v2` then observe for 10m. If p95 > 500ms or 5xx rate > 0.5% escalate and run `rclient deploy revert --model model-embed-v1.9 --route embeddings`.

deploy-bot: NOTE: automation suppressed. Manual commands available in runbook: https://runbook.internal/rollback-embed. Will emit deployment events in #deploy-notifications when executed.

Riley: I'll watch telemetry and logs. Ping here with 10m check.

Anika: Drafting customer blurb now; will post to the release-notes channel and to the support queue if we revert.

Tomo: executing slice now -> setting to 5%

deploy-bot: ACTION: traffic slice change applied by tomo (user). New slice=5%.

Riley: 3m in — p95 down to 410ms. 5xx hold at 0.12%. Looks promising.

Maya: nice. keep monitoring. if anything drifts send +page to infra oncall.

Tomo: 10m check -> p95 steady ~420ms, 5xx 0.1%. No rollback. Leaving slice at 5% for another 15m and then gradually increase if stable.

Anika: I'll update the release notes to say: "Canary observed elevated latency on model-embed-v2; engineering throttled canary traffic and will continue monitoring. No customer-facing rollback required at this time." Draft posted to #release-notes-drafts. :white_check_mark:

Simon: RL-173600 created and linked to canary telemetry. Assigned to Simon for ticket tracking.

Maya: closing the decision thread — manual rollback avoided for now. We have action items: (1) Tomo to continue monitoring + incremental ramping, (2) Anika to publish release note blurb and support guidance, (3) Riley/SRE to keep an eye on shard 4 logs. Reopen thread if any signal breaches thresholds. :lock:

Tomo: ack, leaving extra watch on logs and will escalate immediately if we see p95 > 500ms or 5xx > 0.5%.

deploy-bot: SUMMARY: manual intervention executed (traffic-slice rollback) — automation still suppressed due to change-window.
